properties.name: Downtown Loop
properties.notes: Central interchange hub for all regional spokes — west corridor via Oak Park to Oakbrook.

properties.name: O'Hare International (ORD)
properties.notes: Northwest airport terminus — twin-tube links include Downtown and Lombard.

properties.name: Oak Park
properties.notes: Near-west hub in Oak Park along the I-290 corridor — twin-tube links to Downtown, Oakbrook, O'Hare, and Midway.

properties.name: Oakbrook Center
properties.notes: West-suburban retail / employment node — east to Oak Park/Downtown, west/northwest to Lombard and Woodridge.

properties.name: Lombard
properties.notes: DuPage hub in Lombard (near Yorktown corridor) — twin-tube links to Oakbrook, Woodridge, and O'Hare.

properties.name: Woodridge
properties.notes: Woodridge hub at the I-88 / I-355 interchange — park-and-ride access; links to Oakbrook, Naperville, and Lombard.

properties.name: Naperville
properties.notes: Western suburban hub — links via Woodridge toward Oakbrook/Downtown, twin-tube to Woodfield, and south via Bolingbrook toward Joliet.

properties.name: Bolingbrook
properties.notes: Southwest suburban hub in Bolingbrook, splitting the Naperville–Joliet twin-tube corridor along the I-55 approach.

properties.name: Woodfield Mall
properties.notes: Northwest suburban interchange (Schaumburg) — twin-tube links to O'Hare, Naperville, and Evanston.

properties.name: South Shore Border Hub
properties.notes: Southeast metro hub near Illinois–Indiana border — links to Downtown and Joliet.

properties.name: Joliet
properties.notes: Southwest suburban hub — twin-tube links to Midway, South Shore Border, and Bolingbrook (toward Naperville); no Downtown corridor.

properties.name: Evanston
properties.notes: North-shore lakefront hub (Evanston / Northwestern area) — twin-tube links to Downtown and Woodfield.
